svg.title: OL-RESTORE opener plates: red-ink proclamation craft on Press Black
svg.desc: Four chapter plates for An Open Letter chs. XI–XIV: a posted-bill diptych split by a red axis; a dam wall shedding bills into a red torrent; a letters-patent sheet with directorate key and Trust seal; a commission scroll over an ember starfield. No letterforms baked in; all titles are HTML overlays.
